chapters.title: An Address That Counts
chapters.premise: Aren Vale wants a route with a wage, a room of his own, and enough time to sit in it. Tonight, the city has other demands.

panels.alt: Night city bridges carry small couriers between warm inhabited windows. Aren crosses toward the upper admission gate.

panels.alt: Aren and Sera emerge onto an inhabited lower-city terrace. Adults sweep thresholds, laundry hangs between balconies, and a tiny metalworking shop glows at the next door. Aren’s bag is one solid burden against his left side.
At the metalworker’s threshold, Aren gives Rusk a held personal letter selected from the bag. Rusk, an adult man in a blue work apron, recognizes the handwriting before he touches the seal.

copy.speaker: Rusk
copy.text: She thinks I stopped answering.

lettering.speaker: Rusk
lettering.text: She thinks I stopped answering.

panels.alt: Rusk places his waiting reply on Aren’s open hand. Aren faces him squarely, leaving room for the man’s concern instead of turning the exchange into a joke.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: I can take your answer.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: I can take your answer.

crop.operation: lossless rectangular PNG crop; no scaling or retouch

panels.alt: Sera watches Rusk sign the current-door sheet on a firm board against his own threshold. Behind his signing hand, the open shop contains active tools and an unfinished hinge. Aren tucks Rusk’s reply into the gray bag.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: This is the door you collect from?

copy.speaker: Rusk
copy.text: Every working day.

lettering.speaker: Sera
lettering.text: This is the door you collect from?

lettering.speaker: Rusk
lettering.text: Every working day.

panels.alt: At the next stair junction Aren follows an old arrow toward a shuttered upper doorway. Hessa calls from her open home on the landing below. He stops on a broad supported step and looks down, caught by a practical mistake.

copy.speaker: Hessa
copy.text: Down here. The sign never moved with me.

lettering.speaker: Hessa
lettering.text: Down here. The sign never moved with me.

crop.operation: lossless rectangular PNG crop; no scaling or retouch

panels.alt: Sera crouches beside Hessa’s real threshold to amend the door location in her ledger. Aren waits on the landing, looking back at the misleading arrow and understanding how a returned letter could be produced without anyone checking.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: I will record both: the old sign and this entrance.

lettering.speaker: Sera
lettering.text: I will record both: the old sign and this entrance.

panels.alt: Hessa signs the corrected sheet on her door shelf and passes Aren a warm wrapped roll with her free hand. Aren accepts it with an unguarded smile; the empty sleeve tear and overworked shoulder make the small kindness visible.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Thank you.

lettering.speaker: Hessa
lettering.text: You missed breakfast.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Thank you.

panels.alt: The final door belongs to a night caretaker. Aren notices a sleeping household just inside the ajar entrance and uses a gentle two-knuckle tap instead of the heavy bell beside it. Sera waits back from the doorway.

copy.speaker: Dain

lettering.speaker: Dain
lettering.text: Keep it quiet. I have only just got them to sleep.

panels.alt: Dain accepts a personal envelope from Aren at the threshold and signs the witness sheet resting on a little shelf. Aren gives him a small nod; Sera records the completed handoff without speaking over the quiet household.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: I will.

panels.alt: Back on the terrace, Sera compares the collected doorstep sheet with the real row of open homes. Aren settles the fuller outgoing bag at his feet and waits while she writes what she personally observed.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: These doors. These names. I can stand behind that.

lettering.speaker: Sera
lettering.text: These doors. These names. I can stand behind that.

panels.alt: From Aren’s viewpoint on the broad safe landing, Sera’s open ledger and burgundy-sleeved pointing hand fill one foreground corner. Beyond the book, the actual maintenance bridge has a missing tread section. A separate intact stone stair starts on their own landing and rises along the near building wall, visibly reachable without crossing the gap. Sera rules out the broken span; both people remain supported before it.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: This span cannot go on a public return route.

lettering.speaker: Sera
lettering.text: This span cannot go on a public return route.

panels.alt: Aren turns away from the tempting short bridge and heads toward the long, intact stair climbing around its outer wall. He lifts the bag by its handle before resetting the narrow shoulder strap.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Then we take the long stair.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Then we take the long stair.

crop.operation: lossless rectangular PNG crop; no scaling or retouch

panels.alt: Halfway up the broad stair, Aren braces the gray bag on a waist-high stone rest and eases the strap off his sore left shoulder. Sera waits beside him; nobody is falling and the entrusted mail stays dry.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: Set it down. We have time for one breath.

lettering.speaker: Sera
lettering.text: Set it down. We have time for one breath.

crop.operation: lossless rectangular PNG crop; no scaling or retouch

panels.alt: Pell reaches the stair rest from the repaired entrance below, carrying only his small tool roll. He studies the deep crease that the narrow bag strap has left in Aren’s jacket and shifts the bag to the center of the stone rest without taking its custody.

copy.speaker: Pell
copy.text: One strap doing two shoulders’ work.

lettering.speaker: Pell
lettering.text: One strap doing two shoulders’ work.

crop.operation: lossless rectangular PNG crop; no scaling or retouch

panels.alt: Aren lifts the bag with both hands by its handle for the final level approach while Pell walks alongside and Sera leads toward the office. He carries it upright with visible effort and accepts the steadier method.

crop.operation: lossless rectangular PNG crop; no scaling or retouch

panels.alt: At the office counter, Aren has removed the same yellow folder from the gray bag and laid it open on the countertop; its petition stays visibly inside and the bag rests at his feet. Sera adds the three witnessed-door entries and her route sketch to this folder, marking the long intact stair as the manual route and crossing out the broken shortcut.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: Inspected entrance. Occupied doors. The broken span is excluded.

lettering.speaker: Sera
lettering.text: Inspected entrance. Occupied doors. The broken span is excluded.

crop.operation: lossless crop; no resize or retouch

panels.alt: Maret compares the newly witnessed entries against her address register. She finds the same names under an older landing designation and follows the page with her pencil; Aren leans forward, waiting for the conclusion.

copy.speaker: Maret
copy.text: They are still in the old book. The route was closed; the names were never removed.

lettering.speaker: Maret
lettering.text: They are still in the old book. The route was closed; the names were never removed.

crop.operation: lossless crop; no resize or retouch

panels.alt: Maret turns the current register toward the signed inspection and writes a manual return-route entry. Sera watches her finish. Aren releases a breath he has held too long.

copy.speaker: Maret
copy.text: I can receive the petition now. Replies can travel by the inspected stair.

lettering.speaker: Maret
lettering.text: I can receive the petition now. Replies can travel by the inspected stair.

crop.operation: lossless crop; no resize or retouch

panels.alt: The clerk presses her receipt stamp onto a plain case acknowledgment while her other hand keeps the petition inside the office’s incoming tray. Aren watches the paper impression settle; Sera gives a small satisfied nod.

copy.speaker: Maret
copy.text: Received. Manual return route registered.

lettering.speaker: Maret
lettering.text: Received. Manual return route registered.

crop.operation: lossless crop; no resize or retouch

panels.alt: Maret has given Aren the dated acknowledgment and sorting-carriage docket. They are now safely folded inside his cream dispatch wallet, which he closes with one hand. His other hand rests on the still-full gray bag, now supported on a low ledge beside the counter; he smiles toward Maret, keeping the rest of the round in view.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Something I can bring back.

copy.speaker: Maret
copy.text: And somewhere we can send an answer.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Something I can bring back.

lettering.speaker: Maret
lettering.text: And somewhere we can send an answer.

crop.operation: lossless crop; no resize or retouch

panels.alt: From a small equipment cupboard behind her counter, Maret places a folded practical load-spreader beside the gray bag. Pell recognizes the two broad padded shoulder straps and the broad hip belt. Aren looks from the issued kit to his compressed shoulder.

copy.speaker: Maret
copy.text: Registered carriage includes a load kit. It belongs to your route.

lettering.speaker: Maret
lettering.text: Registered carriage includes a load kit. It belongs to your route.

panels.alt: In the office’s adjacent fitting alcove, Pell finishes fastening the same gray bag securely to the new harness on Aren’s back. The bag’s former loose shoulder strap is rolled and tied to its side. Sera steadies the empty harness buckle guide, not the bag’s weight.

crop.operation: lossless crop; no resize or retouch

panels.alt: Aren stands upright on the fitting floor with the bag’s unchanged load shared across his shoulders and hips. Pell presses two fingers against the hip belt to show where it bears weight; Aren rolls one shoulder cautiously and realizes it no longer twists him sideways.

copy.speaker: Pell
copy.text: Shoulders and hips share the bag. Your line still pulls only you.

lettering.speaker: Pell
lettering.text: Shoulders and hips share the bag. Your line still pulls only you.

crop.operation: lossless crop; no resize or retouch

panels.alt: A sorting porter offers an additional small bundle beside the alcove. Aren’s existing bag is already fastened to his harness. He considers the offered bundle, then pauses with an open palm toward it, leaving it on the porter’s counter. He makes the limit his own choice.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Next trip. I want this one delivered whole.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Next trip. I want this one delivered whole.

crop.operation: lossless crop; no resize or retouch

panels.alt: At the adjacent sorting hall, Aren shows his authorized carriage docket to a receiving attendant who opens the courier access gate. Beyond it, a designated short transfer lane crosses a narrow sorting shaft to a slightly lower receiving platform with a stout fixed metal post. Sera observes from the supported departure deck. The ordinary longer perimeter walkway and a staff doorway beside the receiving table are visible around the sorting shaft; Sera will walk that route. The short magic transfer is optional authorized courier work, separate from the inspected public return stair.

copy.speaker: Attendant
copy.text: Receiving deck. Use the fixed post.

lettering.speaker: Attendant
lettering.text: Receiving deck. Use the fixed post.

panels.alt: Aren makes the short controlled transfer toward the receiving platform. His anatomical RIGHT hand holds the crescent with its blade pointing clear of his path. One cyan line connects the pommel ring behind his right fist to the fixed post on the destination deck. The secured gray bag stays centered on his back, without swinging away.

With the receiving deck just beneath his boots, Aren uses Hold to finish the transfer before its rail. His attention stays on the stop, jaw quiet and shoulders level. The bag remains snug against the harness; no parcel flies free.

Fully supported at the receiving table, Aren has already shut off the line, sheathed the sword, unbuckled the bag and set it on the tabletop. In this single moment he holds the gray bag open while the attendant lifts ordinary outgoing letters into sorting trays. The old single strap remains rolled and tied to the bag side; both of Aren’s hands are occupied only with the bag.

copy.speaker: Attendant
copy.text: All seals dry.

lettering.speaker: Attendant
lettering.text: All seals dry.

Sera watches from the accessible staff doorway at the table’s side after taking the ordinary perimeter walkway.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Thank you for writing the return address in full.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Thank you for writing the return address in full.

copy.speaker: Ossa
copy.text: They have written us a return address. In their own book.

lettering.speaker: Ossa
lettering.text: They have written us a return address. In their own book.

lettering.text: I want it.

copy.text: Ask me about the rent after your first week.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: I will.

lettering.text: Ask me about the rent after your first week.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: I will.

panels.alt: Pell lays an old maintenance copy beside Sera’s new signed survey work order on the sorting table. He points through the open stair window to a small cyan route beacon on the nearby lift structure. Its steady light is plainly visible in daylight; no creature is shown beside it.

copy.speaker: Pell
copy.text: That beacon was marked dark when they closed the circuit.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: Then we start by finding its supply.

lettering.speaker: Pell
lettering.text: That beacon was marked dark when they closed the circuit.

lettering.speaker: Sera
lettering.text: Then we start by finding its supply.

panels.alt: Outside, the repaired postal entrance stays open below the small steadily lit beacon on its neighboring lift tower. In a warm foreground window, Aren, Ossa, Pell and Sera bend over the real work orders around their table. The city beyond is vast and inhabited; their one registered route is a modest bright part of it.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: After the morning post. They know where to send the answer now.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: After the morning post. They know where to send the answer now.

chapters.title: The Light Between Addresses
chapters.premise: Aren has a paid morning route. A beacon marked dark still shines beside its silent lift.

panels.alt: The following morning, Aren reaches Hessa’s actual lower door by the registered stair. She has turned the little old directional board toward her current landing. He offers her ordinary post from the gray bag, standing comfortably under its two broad straps.

copy.speaker: Caption
copy.text: The next morning.

copy.speaker: Hessa
copy.text: You found me without the shouting.

lettering.speaker: Caption
lettering.text: The next morning.

lettering.speaker: Hessa
lettering.text: You found me without the shouting.

copy.speaker: Dain
copy.text: That is the knock. Thank you.

lettering.speaker: Dain
lettering.text: That is the knock. Thank you.

panels.alt: At the guarded upper service walkway, the three stop behind a sound rail. The small cyan beacon stands on a fixed shelf below them beside a stationary postal goods lift. A loose shade edge shifts in the breeze, moving a narrow reflection of its steady light across the lift’s metal suspension collar; the safe public stair continues along the opposite wall.

A single modest glass ray glides into the open space outside the rail. Its translucent navy wings span about two adult arm-lengths. As the beacon’s sweep moves across the suspension collar, its head turns with the moving reflection.

copy.speaker: Aren

lettering.text: It is waiting for the light to move.

panels.alt: Sera closes the service access gate and places the survey barrier across its doorway. Aren points a passing worker toward the still-open ordinary stair on the other side; the worker takes that clear path.

lettering.speaker: Sera
lettering.text: Use the public stair while we check the lamp.

copy.text: The old feed is capped. This branch has no date.

lettering.speaker: Pell
lettering.text: The old feed is capped. This branch has no date.

panels.alt: Back in the same open service-bay geography, the beacon is dark. With no cyan reflection on the collar, the ray lifts its beak away and pauses, its translucent wings still drifting in the air.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: There you are.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: There you are.

panels.alt: At the dark beacon, Pell shows the loose old shade: its open side faces the exposed suspension collar instead of the fenced guide pane. Sera can see the straight sightline between the shade opening and collar from the protected walkway. Rusk arrives from his visibly open nearby workshop carrying his ordinary tool case, answering Pell’s call; he remains on the supported walkway.

copy.speaker: Pell
copy.text: The shade is turned toward the suspension. The guide pane is below it.

lettering.speaker: Pell
lettering.text: The shade is turned toward the suspension. The guide pane is below it.

copy.speaker: Rusk
copy.text: The light can reach the guide without washing the whole landing.

lettering.speaker: Rusk
lettering.text: The light can reach the guide without washing the whole landing.

panels.alt: Aren lifts only the small new shade and places it inside his empty gray bag. Rusk closes the heavy tool case with the removed old shade secured beside its tools. Aren adjusts the familiar harness hip belt and declines the offered case with a small shake of his head.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: The shade is enough. Take the tools by the stair.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: The shade is enough. Take the tools by the stair.

panels.alt: From an outboard upper service opening, Sera points across a short diagonal air gap to the same fixed maintenance shelf a modest step below. The camera now looks down and inward so the two open gate mouths and their separate floor lips are visible, with open air between them in front of the masonry. The existing dark lantern stanchion has a visible bolted base and low black shaft on that shelf; it is the fixed metal anchor, separate from the stationary goods car below. Behind both thresholds, Pell and Rusk follow the intact wall-side return stair and continuous landing through the shelf’s ordinary rear gate with the closed heavy tool case.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: Fixed post. Clear shelf. I will watch the landing.

lettering.speaker: Sera
lettering.text: Fixed post. Clear shelf. I will watch the landing.

panels.alt: Aren makes the short transfer toward the fixed shelf. His RIGHT hand holds the crescent clear of his path; one thin cyan line runs from its rear pommel ring to the shelf’s bolted black post. The small gray bag stays centered on the harness.

A moment after completing the short transfer, Aren stands fully on the same fixed destination shelf. He has released the line and sheathed his crescent at his RIGHT hip. Both soles rest on the clear front-left floor before the single raised central socket; his knees soften and he lets out a quiet steadying breath. The closed gray bag is still centered on his back, unopened.

After the settled arrival, Aren and Pell stand compactly on the same fixed work shelf: Aren on its front-left clear floor, Pell just inside the ordinary rear gate on the rear-left clear floor. From a new high viewpoint at the return stair, all four boot soles and the original shelf perimeter are visible around the single raised socket to their right. Aren passes Pell the one compact shade at waist-to-chest height. His gray bag already rests open and empty on the adjacent masonry ledge. Rusk remains on the last ordinary stair with the closed case containing the removed old shade and tools.

On the same stable work shelf, Rusk seats and supports the new compact shade on the dark side-hung lamp while Pell steadies the separate adjacent suspension collar for inspection. The shade has a single narrow lower aperture, with the framed guide pane below the lamp and the exposed collar distinctly to its side. Aren watches with empty hands from the adjoining supported landing; Sera checks the intended alignment from its guardrail. The lamp stays dark until the subsequent test.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: The collar is outside the light path.

lettering.text: The collar is outside the light path.

panels.alt: A new tactile close view isolates Pell’s two mustard-cuffed gloved hands examining the intact silver suspension collar and its continuous restrained cable. The existing fixed guard and stone landing edge establish his ordinary supported work position. Sera’s ledger and writing hand may appear at the guarded edge as she records the local check. The lamp and goods car are outside this close camera.

Pell has returned down the ordinary service stair to the established LOWER pump-cabinet landing. He uses his retained key to remove the lamp-branch lock, then restores that same enclosed lamp switch. The domestic pump indicator remains lit. Above and beyond him, Aren, Sera and Rusk wait behind the closed UPPER guardrail, watching the corrected narrow cyan strip fall onto the guide pane while the exposed collar stays dark. The work shelf and stopped goods car are empty; the distant ray does not turn toward the collar.

After Pell rejoins the upper walkway by the ordinary service stair, the empty goods car finishes its short climb at the upper loading stop, level with the fixed shelf and clear of the dark exposed collar. Pell watches the stopped runner while Sera watches the matched platform edges.

The same gray bag, now containing one modest plain wrapped workshop test bundle, rides down inside the goods car. From behind the closed service gate the team watches it travel steadily. Its open top reveals the single test bundle; no person rides with it.

lettering.text: This circuit. These two stops. Mail only.

lettering.speaker: Sera
lettering.text: Observed supply. Corrected light path. One tested postal circuit.

panels.alt: Maret places the substantive reply to the petition beside the restored current-door entries. She reads its decision to Aren and Sera before folding it, allowing Aren to hear that the neighbors’ evidence actually changed the working record.

copy.speaker: Maret
copy.text: The witnessed addresses are back in the current register. Regular collection is approved.

lettering.speaker: Maret
lettering.text: The witnessed addresses are back in the current register. Regular collection is approved.

panels.alt: At Maret’s counter, the folded reply and certified old closure copy already lie together inside ONE open cream envelope. Maret lowers its flap; one blue office seal is ready beside it for the next ordinary step. Aren waits with empty hands on the counter. The old instruction’s contents remain hidden.

copy.speaker: Maret
copy.text: The old instruction is enclosed. Your correction has to travel with its history.

lettering.speaker: Maret
lettering.text: The old instruction is enclosed. Your correction has to travel with its history.

panels.alt: The envelope is now closed with its blue office seal. Aren’s LEFT fingers finish lowering this single entrusted reply into the empty gray bag resting open on the counter. Sera’s dispatch witness signature is already complete beside the bag, and her brown ledger is closed.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Lower Post. I know the door.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Lower Post. I know the door.

panels.alt: At the upper end of the newly inspected local circuit, Aren sets the closed gray bag inside the stopped goods car and steps behind the latched gate. The ordinary descending stair is visible beside him; he will meet the bag below.

The goods car arrives level with Lower Post’s receiving shelf. Aren reaches it from the adjoining ordinary stair as Ossa opens the inside hatch. He places the stopped bag on the fixed counter and opens it toward her.

Aren hands the one still-sealed cream envelope to Ossa across her own sorting counter. She supports it with both hands and studies the written destination before opening it; neighbors wait in the warm hall behind her.

copy.speaker: Ossa
copy.text: They have sent us an answer.

lettering.speaker: Ossa
lettering.text: They have sent us an answer.

panels.alt: Ossa opens the envelope and lays its official reply on the sorting table. Rusk, Hessa and Dain lean close as she reads their entries aloud. The still-folded closure-copy enclosure rests beneath the opened envelope, unread.

copy.speaker: Ossa
copy.text: Rusk. Hessa. Dain. In the current register.

copy.speaker: Rusk
copy.text: Then she can write back.

lettering.speaker: Ossa
lettering.text: Rusk. Hessa. Dain. In the current register.

lettering.speaker: Rusk
lettering.text: Then she can write back.

panels.alt: Ossa signs Aren’s receipt for the reply and passes the signed copy back to him. The original delivered reply stays under her palm; beyond her shoulder the newly usable receiving hatch remains open.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Please keep that one.

copy.speaker: Ossa
copy.text: I intend to.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Please keep that one.

lettering.speaker: Ossa
lettering.text: I intend to.

panels.alt: Sera pays the previously agreed survey carrying fee against the completed order. Aren sets the earned coins beside his morning savings packet, then removes his gloves and sits at the sorting table as Ossa serves a simple late meal.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: Carrying work complete.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Then I can sit for this one.

lettering.speaker: Sera
lettering.text: Carrying work complete.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Then I can sit for this one.

panels.alt: While Aren eats, Sera unfolds the certified old closure copy from the delivered envelope. Its second entry names Bell Basin. Rusk places a recent ordinary workshop invoice beside it, pointing to the same place in its return line.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: This instruction closes Bell Basin too.

copy.speaker: Rusk
copy.text: I bought hinges there last month.

lettering.speaker: Sera
lettering.text: This instruction closes Bell Basin too.

lettering.speaker: Rusk
lettering.text: I bought hinges there last month.

panels.alt: Final tall frame: the local goods car waits level at the open postal hatch, its shielded beacon throwing only a narrow cyan guide. Above, Aren sits among the neighbors in warm light with his saved wages beside the meal. Beyond their window the vast city has many other occupied lights; the closed instruction lies open on their table.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Then we take them a copy. After the morning post.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Then we take them a copy. After the morning post.

panels.alt: Pell transfers the closed BLACK envelope with broken silver-circle seal into Aren’s open LEFT palm. Aren’s right hand rests on his sheathed crescent hilt. Both stand on the upper landing.

copy.speaker: Pell
copy.text: Keep it dry. They have waited long enough.

lettering.speaker: Pell
lettering.text: Keep it dry. They have waited long enough.

panels.alt: Aren tucks the black envelope completely inside his inner chest pocket using his LEFT hand. His RIGHT hand draws the crescent sword. Pell watches from the upper stair.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Inside the coat. Both hands free to work.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Inside the coat. Both hands free to work.

panels.alt: Aren steps off the upper stair toward the landing THREE metres down-right. One thin cyan line runs from the pommel ring behind his RIGHT fist to the BLACK metal post on that lower landing. Sword points left, away from the line. Empty left arm balances; boots airborne.

Aren applies Hold and slows at the lower landing. Boots touch stone; his LEFT elbow catches the projecting iron tooth beside the post, making one clear tear in the ivory LEFT sleeve. His right sword points down-left; cyan line remains ring-to-post, taut during his last braking instant; boots are just making contact.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Hold—

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Hold—

panels.alt: Fully supported on the lower landing, Aren releases the line. His right hand lowers the now-dark pommel sword; he looks down at the torn LEFT sleeve, left arm relaxed and empty. The handrail tooth is beside him, the closed wicket behind him.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: I stopped.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: You did. Next time, before the railing.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: I stopped.

lettering.speaker: Sera
lettering.text: You did. Next time, before the railing.

panels.alt: Aren draws the intact BLACK envelope back out with his LEFT hand, relieved to check its unbroken seal. Right sword hangs low, pommel dark. Torn LEFT sleeve and torn hem remain visible.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Still dry.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Still dry.
